column1: # Spec 59 known differences: a case XLibur is known to answer differently from Excel. function, case id, xlibur answer, excel answer, reason, issue.
# A row must carry a reason. The runner fails on a row that now agrees, and on one whose XLibur answer changed.

column5: AND("") is #VALUE! in Excel and TRUE in XLibur
Overflow of a double: Excel returns #NUM!; XLibur throws ArgumentException
Excel refuses COUNTIF with a non-reference first argument at entry; XLibur accepts it and returns #VALUE!
